scope.checkpoint: atomic after each complete cell; existing result or checkpoint refused
scope.endpoint: RFC 3629 Unicode scalar UTF-8; ASCII 00..7F accepted; initial states boundary/remain1/remain2/remain3; true terminal boundary
scope.enumeration: every width! permutation in lexicographic order; no cap
scope.external_iv: arbitrary and unsearched; tested suffix begins at each backend block size
scope.keys_and_block_conventions: exactly those pinned by utf8_search controls
scope.negative_storage: complete row-stream SHA256, complete first-witness SHA256 and reason counts, first/last row
scope.survivors: retain every order/backend/full suffix and independently gather/decrypt/re-encrypt under two IVs
scope.unit: hex characters interpreted as byte pairs after inverse character AMSCO
